tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud Developer & Master Data Integration Specialist
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring, RESTful APIs, data modeling, and PIM/ERP/MDM integration. Proven delivery of product data pipelines, data standards enforcement, catalog synchronization, and cross-functional process optimization. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with strong analytical skills and international stakeholder management.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: MDM Market lead
cover_en.hook: Mars's mission to drive the digitization of commerce and elevate data standards across the European landscape closely aligns with my technical background. With over 5 years of professional experience building enterprise platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in master data management, PIM solutions, and cross-functional system integration.

bullets.label: Master Data & PIM Integration
bullets.text: Designed, built, and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub to maintain synchronized product catalogs across global channels.

bullets.label: SAP Data Processes
bullets.text: Investigated and resolved integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM, and Profisee platforms, working directly with international technical teams to ensure data consistency.

bullets.label: Cross-Functional Analysis
bullets.text: Operated in a techno-functional capacity bridging business and IT, analysing requirements, mapping processes, and translating business needs into robust system solutions.

bullets.label: Data Quality & Operations Support
bullets.text: Managed core data components, custom interceptors, and data flows to ensure compliance with data standards and support day-to-day business operations.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit, I am serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026 and am available to start on 16 December 2026. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my technical expertise can support Mars.

tailoring.why_company: I want to work at Mars because your digital transformation and focus on commerce digitization present an exciting environment for data and technology. Applying my expertise in SAP systems, PIM, and master data integration at Mars allows me to directly support robust data standards and operational excellence across your European landscape.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of SAP Commerce, master data integration, and cross-functional process analysis experience to support Mars's digital commerce and data quality objectives.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years building enterprise SAP Commerce platforms and PIM/MDM data integrations at Rockwell and Shell, I am very interested in the MDM Market Lead role at Mars. My CV and cover letter are ready. I would love to connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for MDM Market lead - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the MDM Market lead position at Mars. With over five years of professional experience in enterprise SAP platforms, master data management, PIM solutions, and cross-functional integrations at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am well-equipped to support your data standards and system operations.

I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit, serving a notice period until 15 December 2026, with an earliest start date of 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to Mars.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
